title: More Reps Before the Burn: What Beta-Alanine Actually Does
description: That tingle is not the point. Beta-alanine raises muscle carnosine so you buffer acid longer and squeeze out extra reps in the 60 second to 4 minute range. Here is the dose and timing the research supports. #betaalanine #preworkout #musclebuilding #sportsnutrition #fuelnfithub
